map.E0 和 E1 什么区别？: What is the difference between E0 and E1?

map.稳定性系数怎么看？: How to read the stability coefficient?
map.稳定性≥0.10 为一般合格门槛；数值越大越不易倾覆，儿童家具等另有更严要求。: Stability≥0.10 is the general pass threshold; the larger the value, the less likely to overturn; children furniture has stricter requirements.

map.本页为纯阈值判定，无计算公式：甲醛释放量 ≤1.5 mg/L 达标（≤0.5 进: This page is a pure threshold check with no formula: a formaldehyde emission ≤1.5 mg/L passes (≤0.5 is further graded E0), a load ≥1000 N passes, durability ≥10000 cycles passes, and a stability value ≥0.10 passes; all four must pass for overall compliance. Validation: missing inputs default to 0 with no strict checks; the applicable standard is GB/T 3324 for wood furniture, GB/T 3325 for metal furniture and QB/T 1952.1 for upholstered furniture. Criteria: all four pass with formaldehyde ≤0.5 → premium (E0), all pass → first grade (E1), only formaldehyde and load pass → acceptable, otherwise rejected.
map.本页为演示性阈值对照，不是标准合格认证：甲醛释放量 ≤1.5 mg/L、加载力: This page compares demo thresholds and is not a standard compliance certificate: formaldehyde ≤1.5 mg/L, load force ≥1000 N, durability ≥10000 cycles and stability ≥0.10; only all four passing shows “demo verdict: all passed”, otherwise “one or more items failed”. The four items use uniform demo thresholds; furniture type only selects the reference standard (wood GB/T 3324, metal GB/T 3325, upholstered QB/T 1952.1). Actual limits, test methods and grade definitions must follow current standard clauses and a test report. E0/E1 are formaldehyde band hints only: ≤0.5 suggests E0 and ≤1.5 suggests E1, not a certification of the whole item.
map.采购前质量核对：把甲醛释放量、加载力、耐久次数、稳定性四项检测值逐项录入，检查是: Pre-purchase check: enter formaldehyde, load force, durability and stability item by item and look for missing values.
map.品控演示：按统一演示阈值给出“全部通过/存在不达标”，用于内部初筛，不替代标准条: QC demo: uniform demo thresholds give “all passed / one or more failed” for internal screening; not a substitute for standard clauses or third-party testing.
map.标准参考：按木家具、金属家具、软体家具提示对应参考标准，E0/E1 只作为甲醛档: Standard reference: wooden, metal and upholstered furniture show their reference standards; E0/E1 are formaldehyde band hints only.
map.木家具：甲醛 0.8 mg/L、加载力 1200 N、耐久 10000 次、稳定: Wooden furniture: formaldehyde 0.8 mg/L, load force 1200 N, durability 10000 cycles, stability 0.15 → all four demo thresholds passed (not a standard certification). If formaldehyde 1, load force 1000 N, durability 0 and stability 0 → one or more items failed; it cannot be called compliant. Negative formaldehyde, negative load, non-integer durability or stability outside 0–5 are rejected.
map.四项里只填甲醛和加载力能判合格吗？: Can I judge compliance with only formaldehyde and load force?
map.不能。四项必须逐项填写，耐久次数与稳定性缺项时直接提示补填；只有四项都达到演示阈: No. All four items must be filled; missing durability or stability triggers a prompt, and only all four meeting the demo thresholds shows “all passed”.
map.E0/E1 代表整件家具已认证吗？: Do E0/E1 mean the whole furniture item is certified?
map.不代表。E0/E1 只是甲醛释放量档位提示，整件家具判定还涉及标准条款、试验方法: No. E0/E1 are formaldehyde band hints only; a full judgement also involves standard clauses, test methods, sampling and a report. This page only demonstrates input checking.
